title: Make vaporize validate-json validate every repeated --path argument

historicalContent.description: During capture validation, a single vaporize validate-json invocation with three repeated --path arguments only printed validation for the final role manifest path. The files were validated successfully only after rerunning validate-json one path at a time. The command should either validate every repeated path or reject repeated --path with an actionable error.
acceptanceCriteria: Add a focused test that invokes validate-json with at least two repeated --path arguments.
Choose and document the intended CLI contract: validate every path or reject repeated --path.
If validating every path, print one validation line or structured receipt item per path and fail the command if any path is invalid.
If rejecting repeated --path, emit an actionable usage error before validating any path.
Update release-doctor or CUJ coverage if validate-json becomes a multi-path release-evidence gate.
